why_new_namespace: G10A was preregistered but had no executable source/data audit/run. G10AR fixes an explicit structurally-disjoint key-space (wxyz) and therefore is a separate registered experiment, not retroactive completion of G10A.
hypotheses: H1: a causal cross-token query-readout adapter improves both-correct paired memory retrieval versus a parameter-matched per-token MLP adapter.
H2: query-readout increases output sensitivity to changing only the queried key without increasing wrong-other-key confusion.
H3: freezing the inherited G8C backbone and training only the adapter preserves fresh non-memory regression within 2 percentage points versus the MLP control.

arms.query_readout_attention: 4-head causal q/k/v/o 96x96 projections plus scalar tanh residual gate
arms.token_mlp_control: 96->192->96 bias-free MLP plus scalar tanh residual gate

optimizer: fresh AdamW on adapter only; lr cosine .001 to .0001; betas(.9,.95), wd .01, clip1
objective: positive completion NLL only; F=<integer>+EOS; identical examples, minibatch group sequence and optimizer-update count in both arms

data.structural_disjointness: All prior G5S/G8C memory generators use keys a/b/c/d. Using w/x/y/z makes every query-invariant memory-history canonical group disjoint by construction. G9QR also targets a/b/c/d and is not reused.
data.split: query-invariant per-key histories split before rendering; cross-key write permutations canonicalize together; per-key chronology retained

inference: prompt strings only; greedy unrestricted byte259; max32 new bytes; EOS required; strict F=<integer>; no solver/gold/case object
selection: fixed step200 endpoints only; validation/held never select checkpoints or hyperparameters
scope: small paired architectural mechanism screen; not 300-800M, not broad reasoning/code evidence, not Qwen parity
no_external_borrow: Adapter is a minimal in-project causal attention/MLP comparison; no Qwen/DeepSeek/TRM weights or code are imported.
